value.rationale: The eight-good four-agent laminar key matroid is one of exactly two currently identified finite bottlenecks in the published decomposition approach to four-agent EF1 with ordered no-envy. The result completely settles its heterogeneous two-level nonnegative valuation class (a continuum), including profiles not handled by the paper’s top-item-dispersion method, with the stronger order property required for component assembly. This is a natural complete finite classification of an explicitly motivated open base case, not an arbitrary computation of a small unmotivated invariant.
